# Real Path of Building PoE2 exports (TC-CODE-REAL, decision 0021)

`tests/test_tc_code_real.py` checks every `*.txt` here: one share code per
file (the text PoB2's Export / Share tab copies), ASCII.

A code goes in this TRACKED folder ONLY with its build owner's permission,
recorded below (date, PoB2 version, who allowed it; no account id, email or
character name). Without permission, drop the code in the gitignored
`ops/runtime/tc_real/` folder instead, or name its file in the env var
`AL_TC_REAL_CODE`; the same checks run and nothing is committed.

With no code anywhere the real-code test skips.
